text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought I knew, but... <chrname>... what an 
incredible run."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, I wonder why. There's no point in 
comparing them. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, not yet. Not yet... but someday, 
I will be just like you—!"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
—I see! Perhaps that movement could also 
apply to ST-2...!
